body:
Verdict: aida review verdict STORY-80 (aida-host). Admission is verified atomic with no stampede, and running builds are never killed. Blocking:
(1) A non-numeric AIDA_CARGO_SLOTS_MAX hangs EVERY build (reproduced). Validate it as ^[0-9]+$, else warn and use the default.
(2) The cooldown is skipped for the first burst slot while another burst is held (:603 cand > slots).
(3) Tests: pin the default 30s cooldown (unset env), add a wrapper high-PSI test for slot 3, and export AIDA_CARGO_MEMINFO for hermeticity.
(4) Add a measurement plan to the PR and log burst-denial reasons. Fix the ADR's worst case (8 rustc jobs, not 4).
Threshold RULING: keep 40 for the first burst slot and use 30 for the second. Status: STORY-80 and ADR-82 were reopened (they were marked completed pre-merge, the second time today). Leave completion to merge time. Mail REWORK READY with the new head.
subject: aida-host PR #10 STORY-80: CHANGES round 1 (4 blocking); threshold ruling inside
